title: Calor y estrés de la zona (ECOSTRESS)

lst.name: ECOSTRESS land surface temperature (LST) 70 m
lst.label: observado
limitations: It is the temperature of the soil or leaves, not the air: in the sun it can exceed air temperature by 10 to 20 °C.
ECOSTRESS rides on the Space Station: it passes at different times of day and not every day; clouds leave gaps.
70 m pixel: it describes the point's surroundings, not the whole field.

esi.name: ECOSTRESS evaporative stress index (ESI) 70 m
esi.label: modelado
limitations: It is a MODELED index: actual / potential evapotranspiration. Near 1 = no stress; near 0 = severe stress.
ECOSTRESS rides on the Space Station: it passes at different times of day and not every day; clouds leave gaps.
70 m pixel: it describes the point's surroundings, not the whole field.

reading: In summer the surface reaches a mean of 42 °C on satellite passes, with 24 observations above 45 °C. Medium vegetation water stress in the last 3 months: ESI 0.58 (similar to normal).
